The SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025 is now officially released on 27th February 2026 on the official website at sbi.co.in. If you appeared for the mains exam , you can now check your result online. The result tells you whether you have qualified and also shows a section-wise score, so you can see how you did in each part of the exam. You can view the result on the official SBI careers website at sbi.bank.in/web/careers. Scroll down the below article to get the direct link to download the SBI Clerk Phase 2 Result 2025.

SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025-26 Out @sbi.co.in

Candidates can now check the SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025 in PDF format on the official website. Over 60,000 candidates appeared for the exam, and a total of 6,589 candidates will be selected for the post of Clerk (Junior Associate) under CRPD/CR/2025-26/06. This is the final step for mains, and selected candidates will now receive their appointment letters from SBI.

SBI Clerk Junior Associate Phase 2 Result 2026

SBI Clerk Mains Result 2026 Download PDF Link Active

The SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025 for Advertisement No: CRPD/CR/2025-26/06 is now available in PDF format on the official SBI website. Candidates who appeared for the mains exam can check their final qualifying status using this result. The PDF contains the roll numbers of all selected candidates for the post of Clerk (Junior Associate). For convenience, a direct link to access the SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025 has been provided here.

SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025-26 Out – Click Here To Download

How to Check SBI Clerk Final Result 2026?

Candidates can easily check their SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025 on the official SBI careers page. Here is a simple step-by-step guide to help you access your final result.

  • Credentials Required: Roll Number or Registration Number
  • Step 1: Visit the official website SBI Careers
  • Step 2: On the homepage, scroll down to find “Current Openings”
  • Step 3: Look for Recruitment of Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales) (Advertisement No: CRPD/CR/2025-26/06)
  • Step 4: Click on the link titled “MAINS RESULT FOR SBI JUNIOR ASSOCIATES FOR EXAM HELD ON 21st NOVEMBER 2025”
  • Step 5: The result PDF will open on the screen
  • Step 6: Use Ctrl + F to search for your roll number in the list of qualified candidates.

SBI Clerk Answer Key 2026

The SBI Clerk Main Exam Result 2026 for the post of Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales) has been announced under Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2025-26/06. Candidates can check the Main Exam Result and Preliminary Exam Result from the official website of the State Bank of India.

As per the notice, the candidate score card with link to download the response sheet along with the answer key will be available from 10.03.2026 onwards.

sbi.co.in Mains Result Live Updates

The exam authority has announced the mains exam result for the SBI Clerk 2026 exam on the official website. Check the live updates for the mains result here.

SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025-26 FAQs

Q1. Is SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025-26 released?

Ans. The SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025 was officially released on 27th February 2026 for candidates who appeared in the mains exam.

Q2. Where can I check the SBI Clerk Phase 2 Result 2026?

Ans. Candidates can check the SBI Clerk Phase 2 Result 2026 in PDF format on the official SBI careers website: sbi.bank.in/web/careers.

Q3. How many candidates will be selected through SBI Clerk Mains 2026?

Ans.  A total of 6,589 candidates will be selected for the post of Clerk (Junior Associate) under Advertisement No: CRPD/CR/2025-26/06.

Q4. What details are mentioned in the SBI Clerk Final Result 2025?

Ans. The result PDF contains the roll numbers of selected candidates and provides a section-wise score for better understanding of performance.

Q5. What should I do after checking my SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025?

Ans. Qualified candidates should download and save the result, and wait for the appointment letters from SBI. Non-qualified candidates will need to wait for the next recruitment cycle.

Q6. When will the SBI Clerk Answer Key be released?

Ans. As per the notice in the image, the SBI Clerk answer key (along with the candidate score card and response sheet link) will be made available from 10.03.2026 onwards on the official website of the State Bank of India
